text.en: Most pet owners praise Dr. Ali and the veterinary nurses at this Oak Cliff clinic for their warm, attentive attitude during consultations. Many clients appreciate that the doctor listens carefully, explains treatment plans without rushing, and shows genuine compassion during difficult end-of-life visits, though two reviewers complained of dismissive front desk service and a rushed exam.

title.en: Mostly fair fees with billing disputes

text.en: Several dog and cat owners describe the clinic rates for vaccinations, kitten examinations, and medications as fair and budget-friendly compared to other Dallas practices. However, feedback on billing is mixed: one client reported not being informed in advance about separate charges for a vaccine and microchip, and another felt the examination fee was too high for a brief check-up.

Reviewers frequently highlight that the clinic accommodates urgent walk-in visits for multiple dogs and calls owners back promptly when waitlist openings appear. Clients also note having unhurried appointments and plenty of time during sensitive visits, although one pet owner felt their examination for flea medication was rushed and lasted under ten minutes.

q.en: Does Edgefield Animal Clinic accept walk-in visits?

a.en: Yes, the clinic accepts walk-in visits, and reviewers mention being seen on the same day or accommodated without a prior booking.

q.en: Is Spanish spoken at Edgefield Animal Clinic?

a.en: Yes, client feedback confirms that veterinary service is available in Spanish.

q.en: What surgical and dental procedures are offered?

a.en: The clinic performs veterinary surgery and dental procedures alongside routine wellness check-ups and vaccinations.

q.en: Can clients join a waitlist if appointments are booked?

a.en: Yes, reviewers note that the front desk maintains a waitlist and calls pet owners when an earlier slot opens up.
